title: Goku Drip
blurb: Drip culture met anime and produced a beat that arrives whenever an outfit goes impossibly hard. The whole thing was canonised by the legendary image of Goku wearing streetwear he has no business owning, and the audio became the official certification of a fit check. Use it for glow-ups, for somebody stepping out with confidence they have not yet earned, and for the moment a person walks into a room and everybody notices at the same time. The drip is non-negotiable. The sound simply files the paperwork.
origin: From the viral 'Drip Goku' meme: Goku in streetwear, awarded maximum drip.
